values: Accumulation: The account is in accumulation phase and will accept payments, rollovers and contributions
Retirement: The account is in retirement phase and funds are accessible
Insurance Only: The account has been established for insurance purposes only, not to fund retirement
Closed: The account has been closed and the member no longer has an interest in the fund
value_source: ATO SPRMBRINFO.0001 2018 Submit Request Message Structure Table (Member Account Attribute Service), alias SPRMBRINFO26 'Individual's account phase', Full Enumeration column; inside the SBR ATO SPRMBR 2018 Package v1.6 ZIP. Confirmed by ATO 'Super fund member reporting - user guide', Appendix 3 data elements page.
rationale: The SAE tables are the PLIDA MAAS/MATS product, and MAAS defines account phase as a mandatory account attribute with exactly this four-value enumeration.
evidence_quote: Accumulation|Retirement|Insurance Only|Closed
supersedes_rationale: The earlier reviewer said the concepts were public but the codes unverified; the SBR message structure table publishes the permitted values verbatim in its Full Enumeration column.

values: Open: The member's account is open
Transition to retirement income stream: The member's account is a transition to retirement income stream (TRIS)
Non capped defined benefit income stream: The member's account is not a capped defined benefit income stream
Capped defined benefit income stream (1 July 2017 onwards): commenced post 1 July 2017
Capped defined benefit income stream (pre 1 July 2017): existed just before 1 July 2017
Market linked capped defined benefit income stream: existed just before 1 July 2017
Closed: The member's account is closed
value_source: ATO SPRMBRINFO.0001 2018 Submit Request Message Structure Table, alias SPRMBRINFO27 'Individual's account status', Full Enumeration column; inside the SBR ATO SPRMBR 2018 Package v1.6 ZIP. The permitted status depends on account phase (MAAS BIG Table 8).
rationale: MAAS 'account status' is the income stream account status reported alongside account phase for every member account, which is exactly this field.
evidence_quote: Open|Transition to retirement income stream|Non capped defined benefit income stream|...|Closed
supersedes_rationale: The earlier determination asked for the released codeframe; the SBR MAAS message structure table is that codeframe and is public.
